				trigger_if = { limit = { var:zg361_p2c_m360_source_c3_quota >= 4 var:zg361_p2c_m360_source_c3_quota >= 5 } NOT = { var:zg361_p2c_m360_source_c3_manager.var:zg361_b1_m360_source_forced_4_character = var:zg361_p2c_m360_source_c3_manager.var:zg361_b1_m360_source_forced_5_character } } trigger_else = { always = yes }
				trigger_if = { limit = { var:zg361_p2c_m360_source_c3_quota >= 4 var:zg361_p2c_m360_source_c3_quota >= 6 } NOT = { var:zg361_p2c_m360_source_c3_manager.var:zg361_b1_m360_source_forced_4_character = var:zg361_p2c_m360_source_c3_manager.var:zg361_b1_m360_source_forced_6_character } } trigger_else = { always = yes }
				trigger_if = { limit = { var:zg361_p2c_m360_source_c3_quota >= 5 var:zg361_p2c_m360_source_c3_quota >= 6 } NOT = { var:zg361_p2c_m360_source_c3_manager.var:zg361_b1_m360_source_forced_5_character = var:zg361_p2c_m360_source_c3_manager.var:zg361_b1_m360_source_forced_6_character } } trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
		}
		$TICKET_OWNER$ = { save_scope_as = zg361_we_al_owner }
		save_scope_as = zg361_we_al_subject
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_we_al_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_we_al_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
		zg361_we_al_schedule_stage_04_deadline_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { $TICKET_OWNER$ = { is_ai = yes } }
			zg361_we_materialize_m360_route_a_from_central_effect = { TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$ TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$ TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { var:zg361_we_adapter_status = 1 var:zg361_we_adapter_status = 2 } }
				zg361_we_m360_route_a_effect = { TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$ TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$ TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m360_event_queued var:zg361_we_m360_event_queued = 1 var:zg361_we_m360_event_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$ var:zg361_we_m360_event_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ var:zg361_we_m360_event_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$ var:zg361_we_m360_event_case = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_status value = 2 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m360_event_queued value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m360_event_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m360_event_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m360_event_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m360_event_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_status value = 1 }
			$TICKET_OWNER$ = { trigger_event = { id = zg361we.360 } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			$TICKET_SUBJECT$ = this
			OR = {
				zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m360_receipt_owner
					RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m360_receipt_subject
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m360_receipt_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m360_receipt_case
					RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m360_receipt_state
					RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m360_receipt_choice
					EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					EXPECTED_STATE = 4
					EXPECTED_CHOICE = 1
				}
				zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m360_receipt_owner
					RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m360_receipt_subject
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m360_receipt_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m360_receipt_case
					RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m360_receipt_state
					RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m360_receipt_choice
					EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					EXPECTED_STATE = 4
					EXPECTED_CHOICE = 2
				}
				zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m360_receipt_owner
					RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m360_receipt_subject
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m360_receipt_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m360_receipt_case
					RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m360_receipt_state
					RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m360_receipt_choice
					EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					EXPECTED_STATE = 4
					EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
				}
			}
		}
		zg361_we_mark_central_m360_source_consumed_effect = { TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$ TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$ TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$ }
		if = {
			limit = { $TICKET_OWNER$ = { has_variable = zg361_p2c_m360_source_status var:zg361_p2c_m360_source_status = 2 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_status value = 2 }
		}
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_status value = 4 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_blocked_reason value = 3604 } }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_status value = 4 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_blocked_reason value = 3604 } }
}
